name: Java
certifications: Oracle Certified Professional: Java SE 21 Developer (1Z0-830)

beginner.summary: No Java experience assumed. Participants learn the language, object-oriented programming, collections, exceptions, files and testing, and finish with a working console application.
prerequisites: Basic computer and file system use
Can install software on their machine
Some logical thinking; earlier programming helps but is not required
outcomes: Write, compile and run Java programs
Model problems with classes, interfaces and inheritance
Use collections, exceptions and file I/O correctly
Build and test a small Maven project

days.topic: Java Setup, JDK and First Program
subtopics: What Java is used for and how the JVM runs bytecode
Installing IntelliJ IDEA and creating a project
The structure of a class with a main method
Compiling with javac and running with java
Running single-file programs with java Hello.java
Packages and the source folder layout
Printing output with System.out.println and printf
days.lab_task: Install JDK 21 and IntelliJ, write a program that prints a formatted receipt for three items, compile it with javac from the terminal and run it both from the terminal and the IDE.
days.deliverable: Receipt program source, terminal compile and run output, and an IDE screenshot
checks: Run javac Receipt.java then java Receipt
Prints three aligned item lines and a total
Compiler reports the line and the missing semicolon
objectives: Explain how Java code becomes running bytecode
Set up a Java development environment

subtopics: The eight primitive types and their ranges
int versus long and integer overflow
Integer division and the remainder operator
days.lab_task: Write a unit converter that converts temperatures, distances and weights, showing correct integer and decimal results and demonstrating one overflow and one rounding issue with an explanation.
days.deliverable: Converter source and a short note explaining the overflow and rounding examples
checks: Multiply Integer.MAX_VALUE by 2 as int and as long
int result is negative, long result is correct

subtopics: Common methods: length, substring, indexOf, replace, split
days.lab_task: Build a text utility that counts words and vowels, reverses each word, checks whether a phrase is a palindrome ignoring case and spaces, and prints a formatted report using a text block.
days.deliverable: Text utility source and sample output for three phrases
checks: Compare two equal strings built at runtime with == and equals
Count words in "  Java   is fun "

days.lab_task: Write a shipping cost calculator that applies rules by country, weight band and membership level using if statements for ranges and a switch expression for country zones.
days.deliverable: Calculator source and a table of ten test inputs with expected costs
checks: Enter a 2 kg parcel to zone A for a member
Prints a clear error instead of a cost
Uses arrow labels with no fall-through

subtopics: Reading input with Scanner in a loop
days.lab_task: Build a number guessing game that reads guesses with Scanner, gives higher or lower hints, rejects non-numeric input, limits attempts to seven and prints a multiplication table on a win.
days.deliverable: Game source and a recorded play session
checks: Guess correctly on the third attempt
Reports three attempts and prints the table
Game ends and reveals the number
objectives: Control loops with break and continue

days.lab_task: Refactor the shipping calculator into small static methods, add overloaded methods for kilograms and pounds, and write a recursive method that computes factorials with input checks.
days.deliverable: Refactored source with each method under 15 lines
checks: Call the overloaded method with pounds
Returns the same cost as the equivalent kilograms
Correct value for 20, clear error for -1
Change a parameter inside a method

subtopics: The Arrays utility class: sort, fill, toString, copyOf
days.lab_task: Write a grade book that stores marks for five students in four subjects in a 2D array, prints averages per student and subject, finds the top student and searches for a mark with binary search.
days.deliverable: Grade book source and printed report
checks: Program catches the exception and explains it
Binary search for a missing mark
objectives: Store and process data in arrays

subtopics: Classes as blueprints and objects as instances
Object lifecycle and garbage collection basics
days.lab_task: Model a library with Book and Member classes, constructors that validate input, equals and hashCode based on ISBN and member ID, and a static counter of created books.
days.deliverable: Library model classes and a main program that demonstrates them
checks: Create two Book objects with the same ISBN
Create a Book with an empty title
toString shows title, author and ISBN
objectives: Design classes with fields and methods

subtopics: Getters, setters and when to avoid setters
days.lab_task: Restructure the library into model, service and app packages, make Book immutable, replace a data class with a record and show that outside code cannot change internal state.
days.deliverable: Packaged project and a note on each access modifier used
checks: Try to change a Book field from another package
Modify a list returned by a getter
Shows generated toString with all components

subtopics: When to prefer composition over inheritance
days.lab_task: Build a payroll program with an abstract Employee class and salaried, hourly and contract subclasses that each override pay calculation, processed polymorphically from one list.
days.deliverable: Payroll source and the printed monthly payslip summary
checks: Run payroll for one of each employee type
Each pay amount matches the rules
No change needed to the payroll loop
Explain why the subclass method is no longer called

days.lab_task: Add a Payable interface implemented by employees and invoices, an enum for departments with budgets, and a sealed Shape hierarchy whose area is computed with pattern matching.
days.deliverable: Source code and output for each feature
checks: Process employees and invoices through Payable
Print the budget for each department

days.lab_task: Add a bank account class that throws a custom InsufficientFundsException, a transfer method that handles failures without losing money, and a reader that uses try-with-resources.
days.deliverable: Source code and output for successful and failed transfers
checks: Custom exception raised and both balances unchanged
Clear message, and the resource is still closed
Read a stack trace from a failed run
Participant identifies the line that failed

subtopics: Why equals and hashCode matter for sets and maps
days.lab_task: Build a word frequency counter over a text file that stores counts in a HashMap, prints the top ten words in order, and lists unique words alphabetically with a TreeSet.
days.deliverable: Counter source and output for the provided text
checks: Top ten words and counts match the answer file
Remove items while iterating with a for-each loop
Explain the ConcurrentModificationException and fix it with an Iterator

subtopics: Sorting lists and arrays of objects
days.lab_task: Write a generic Pair and a generic Repository<T> with add, find and list methods, then sort library books by author then title with a Comparator chain.
days.deliverable: Generic classes, sorting code and output
checks: Add a Member to a Repository<Book>
Uses reversed() without a new class

subtopics: collect with toList, groupingBy and counting
days.lab_task: Load the sales CSV into a list of records and use streams to compute total sales per region, the top five products, the average order value and the customer with the largest order.
days.deliverable: Stream report source and output
checks: Find a product that does not exist
Returns an empty Optional handled without null
Rewrite one loop as a stream

days.lab_task: Write a tool that reads every CSV file in a folder, validates each row, writes valid rows to a combined file and invalid rows with the reason to an errors file.
days.deliverable: Tool source, combined output file and errors file
checks: Combined file has the 47 valid rows
Include a row with a missing price
Row appears in the errors file with the reason
Run against a folder that does not exist
Clear message and non-zero exit code
objectives: Read and write files with java.nio

days.lab_task: Build a meeting planner that converts a meeting time between London, New York and Bangalore, lists the next four weekly dates and computes the days left until a deadline.
days.deliverable: Planner source and output for the provided meetings
checks: Convert 15:00 London on a date in July
Shows the correct New York and Bangalore times
Schedule across the daylight saving change

days.topic: Maven Projects and Unit Testing with JUnit 5
subtopics: The Maven lifecycle: compile, test, package
Running tests in the IDE and with mvn test
days.lab_task: Convert the bank account code into a Maven project, write at least twelve JUnit 5 tests including parameterised and exception tests, and package it as a runnable JAR.
days.deliverable: Maven project, test report and runnable JAR
checks: Break the transfer rule and run tests
At least one test fails with a clear message

subtopics: Breakpoints, step over and step into
days.lab_task: Find and fix five planted bugs in a provided order-processing program using the debugger, write a test that reproduces each bug first, and refactor the longest method.
days.deliverable: Fixed code, five new tests and a bug log with the cause of each
checks: Run the five new tests on the original code
Run them on the fixed code
Show a conditional breakpoint in use
Stops only on the failing order

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Library Management Console Application
subtopics: Domain model with records, enums and classes
days.lab_task: Build a console library system that adds books and members, lends and returns books with due dates and fines, saves to CSV files, prints overdue and popular-book reports and has tests for every rule.
days.deliverable: Maven project, test report, sample data files and a 10-minute demo
checks: Borrow a book that is already lent
Return a book five days late
All data is reloaded from the files
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one application

intermediate.summary: For people who can write basic Java. Covers modern language features, deeper collections and streams, concurrency, databases, build tools, testing and building REST services with Spring Boot.
prerequisites: Writes Java classes, interfaces and collections confidently
Has used exceptions and basic streams
Has built and tested a Maven project
outcomes: Build and test REST services with Spring Boot
Organise multi-module builds with Maven or Gradle

days.topic: Modern Java Language Features from 11 to 21
subtopics: Reading release notes and preview features
days.lab_task: Rewrite an old Java 8 order model into Java 21 using records, a sealed payment hierarchy and pattern-matching switch, keeping all existing tests passing.
days.deliverable: Before and after source with passing tests
checks: Add a new payment type without handling it in the switch
objectives: Model data with records and sealed types

days.lab_task: Refactor a provided 600-line OrderService into classes that follow SOLID, injecting dependencies through constructors so each part can be unit tested on its own.
days.deliverable: Refactored code, class diagram and new unit tests
checks: Only a new class is added
Runs without a database or network

days.lab_task: Implement a notification system using a builder for messages, strategies for email, SMS and push channels, a decorator that adds retry, and an adapter for a third-party SMS client.
days.deliverable: Source code with a short note on why each pattern was chosen
checks: Send a message through each channel
Make the SMS client fail twice
Retry decorator succeeds on the third attempt
Build a message missing a recipient

days.topic: Advanced Collections and Data Structure Choice
days.lab_task: Build a job scheduler that orders jobs by priority with a PriorityQueue, keeps an undo stack with ArrayDeque, and finds jobs in a time range with a TreeMap, then measure lookups with 100,000 jobs.
days.deliverable: Scheduler source and a timing table for each structure
checks: Only jobs in that range are returned
Compare list search with map lookup for 100,000 jobs

subtopics: Parallel streams and when not to use them
days.lab_task: Produce a sales analytics report with nested grouping by region and month, a top-three product list per region, duplicate-key handling in toMap and a comparison of sequential and parallel runs.
days.deliverable: Report source, output and timing comparison
checks: Group sales by region and month
Build a map with duplicate keys
Merge function combines values without an exception
Same result, with a timing note

subtopics: Composing functions with andThen and compose
days.lab_task: Build a validation library that composes reusable Predicate rules, returns all errors for an input, and replaces a long if-else chain with a map of command names to functions.
days.deliverable: Validation library, tests and before and after code
checks: Validate an input with three problems
Run the command map with an unknown command

days.topic: Concurrency: Threads and the Executor Framework
days.lab_task: Download and checksum 50 files concurrently with an ExecutorService, show a race condition in a shared counter, then fix it with an AtomicInteger and with synchronized.
days.deliverable: Concurrent program, race demonstration and fixed versions
checks: Totals vary below the expected number

subtopics: Combining futures with thenCombine and allOf
Error handling with exceptionally and handle
days.lab_task: Build a price comparison service that calls three slow mock suppliers in parallel with CompletableFuture, applies a two-second timeout and fallback, then handles 10,000 requests with virtual threads.
days.deliverable: Service source and timing results for platform and virtual threads
checks: Run 10,000 blocking requests on virtual threads

subtopics: Testing with an embedded or containerised database
days.lab_task: Write a repository class for orders using JDBC with prepared statements, a transfer that runs in one transaction, Flyway migrations and a batch import of 10,000 rows.
days.deliverable: Repository code, migration scripts and import timing
checks: Pass a name containing a quote and an OR clause
Fail the second step of a transfer

subtopics: The persistence context and dirty checking
days.lab_task: Map customers, orders and order lines with JPA, find and fix an N+1 query with a fetch join, and show optimistic locking stopping a lost update.
days.deliverable: Entity code, SQL logs before and after the fix and the locking test
checks: Load 50 orders with lines before the fix
Update the same order from two sessions

days.lab_task: Split the order application into domain, persistence and api modules in Gradle with a version catalog, so the domain module has no database dependency.
days.deliverable: Multi-module Gradle build and a dependency graph
checks: Import a JDBC class into the domain module
Run the build a second time
Tasks are up to date or from cache

days.lab_task: Write unit tests for the order service that mock the repository and the payment gateway, capture the saved order, test every failure path and reach 85 percent line coverage.
days.deliverable: Test suite and JaCoCo coverage report
checks: Test confirms the order is not saved

days.lab_task: Read a 200 MB orders JSON file with the streaming API without running out of memory, map nested orders to records with java.time dates, and write a summary JSON with a custom serialiser for money.
days.deliverable: Parser source, summary JSON and memory usage note
checks: Parse the large file with a 256 MB heap
Read JSON with an extra unknown field
objectives: Convert between JSON and Java objects
Handle dates, unknown fields and polymorphism

days.topic: Calling External APIs with the Java HTTP Client
subtopics: Headers, query parameters and JSON bodies
days.lab_task: Write a client for a weather API that sends authenticated requests, maps JSON responses, retries on 503 with back-off, times out after three seconds and is tested against WireMock stubs.
days.deliverable: Client source and WireMock tests
checks: Client retries and returns the result
Client times out after three seconds
Client raises a clear authentication error without retrying
objectives: Test clients without the real service

days.topic: Spring Core: Dependency Injection and Configuration
days.lab_task: Convert the notification system into a Spring application with constructor-injected channels, a profile that swaps the real SMS client for a fake, and typed configuration properties.
days.deliverable: Spring application and the configuration files
checks: Startup fails with a clear binding error
List the beans with the actuator or a test

days.topic: Building REST APIs with Spring Boot
subtopics: Path variables, query parameters and request bodies
Calling the API with curl and Postman
days.lab_task: Build a products REST API with create, read, update, delete and search endpoints, validation, consistent error responses and OpenAPI documentation.
days.deliverable: API source, OpenAPI page and a Postman collection
checks: Create a product with a negative price
Get a product that does not exist

days.lab_task: Store products in PostgreSQL with Spring Data JPA, add paged and sorted search, a projection for the list view and repository tests that run against a Testcontainers database.
days.deliverable: Repository code and passing database tests
checks: Request page 2 with 10 items sorted by price
Pass against a real PostgreSQL container

days.lab_task: Secure the products API so anyone can read, only users can create and only admins can delete, using JWT login, BCrypt passwords and tests for every rule.
days.deliverable: Security configuration and security tests
checks: Delete a product as a normal user

subtopics: Health checks and custom health indicators
days.lab_task: Add structured logging with a request ID, a custom health indicator for the payment gateway and a metric for orders created, and configure everything from environment variables.
days.deliverable: Configuration, logs and actuator output
checks: Every log line for it carries the same request ID

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Order Management REST Service
subtopics: Testing at unit and integration level
days.lab_task: Build an order management service with products, customers and orders, stock checks in transactions, JWT security, OpenAPI docs, Testcontainers tests, health checks and metrics, then present it.
days.deliverable: Source repository, test reports, OpenAPI page and a 15-minute demo
checks: All tests pass with a real database
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one service

advanced.summary: For working Java developers. Covers JVM internals, memory and garbage collection, performance, advanced concurrency, reactive and event-driven services, microservices, security and running Java in production.
prerequisites: Comfortable with concurrency, JPA and testing
outcomes: Diagnose memory, CPU and latency problems in the JVM
Design reliable concurrent and event-driven systems
Run, secure and observe Java services in containers

subtopics: Class loading phases and class loaders
The JIT compilers C1 and C2
days.lab_task: Inspect bytecode with javap for a lambda and a switch, log JIT compilation for a hot method, and write a custom class loader that loads plugins from a folder.
days.deliverable: javap output, JIT log extract and plugin loader source
checks: Drop a new plugin JAR into the folder
objectives: Explain how the JVM loads and runs code

days.topic: Memory Management and Garbage Collection Tuning
subtopics: Choosing a collector for a workload
days.lab_task: Run a provided allocation-heavy service under load with G1 and ZGC, collect GC logs, and compare pause times and throughput to choose a collector.
days.deliverable: GC logs, comparison table and recommendation
checks: Participant explains the change in GC frequency
objectives: Choose a collector for a workload

days.topic: Diagnosing Memory Leaks with Heap Dumps
days.lab_task: Run a service with a planted cache leak until it runs out of memory, analyse the heap dump to find the leaking objects and their GC root, fix it and show memory staying flat.
days.deliverable: Heap dump analysis, fix and memory graph before and after
checks: Leak suspect points to the cache map
Rerun under the same load after the fix
Show the path to the GC root

days.topic: Performance Profiling with JFR and async-profiler
days.lab_task: Profile a slow endpoint with JFR and async-profiler, find the hot method and a lock contention problem, fix both and show the latency improvement.
days.deliverable: Flame graphs before and after, JFR report and latency numbers
checks: Hot method is visible at the top
Take three thread dumps under load
Blocked threads point to the same lock
Measure p95 latency after the fixes

days.lab_task: Benchmark three ways of building a large string and three ways of looking up keys with JMH, including a deliberately broken benchmark that dead-code elimination ruins.
days.deliverable: JMH project, results table and explanation of the broken benchmark

days.topic: Java Memory Model and Lock-Free Programming
days.lab_task: Show a visibility bug with jcstress, fix it with volatile, then build a lock-free counter and stack with compare-and-set and compare their throughput with lock-based versions.
days.deliverable: jcstress results, lock-free code and throughput comparison
checks: Benchmark lock-free and locked counters at 8 threads

days.topic: Advanced Concurrency: Structured Concurrency and Scoped Values
days.lab_task: Rewrite the price comparison service with structured concurrency so one failure cancels the others, pass the request context with scoped values, and find and fix a pinning problem.
days.deliverable: Rewritten service, pinning trace and tests
checks: Pinning location is identified then removed
Limit supplier calls with a semaphore

days.topic: Reactive Programming with Project Reactor and WebFlux
days.lab_task: Build a WebFlux endpoint that streams stock prices, combines two upstream services with WebClient, retries with back-off and is tested with StepVerifier.
days.deliverable: Reactive service and StepVerifier tests
checks: Make an upstream service fail twice
Block a reactive thread on purpose and run BlockHound

subtopics: Testing with embedded Kafka or Testcontainers
days.lab_task: Publish order events from the order service and consume them in an inventory service, with retries, a dead-letter topic for bad messages and idempotent handling of duplicates.
days.deliverable: Producer and consumer services and integration tests
checks: Moves to the dead-letter topic after retries
Resumes from the committed offset without loss

days.topic: Domain-Driven Design and Hexagonal Architecture in Java
subtopics: Keeping frameworks out of the domain
Package structure for a hexagonal service
days.lab_task: Restructure the order service into a framework-free domain core with aggregates and domain events, ports for persistence and payment, and Spring adapters, enforced with ArchUnit.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, context map and ArchUnit rules
checks: Import a Spring class into the domain package
Add an order line that breaks the aggregate limit
objectives: Model a domain with DDD building blocks

subtopics: Distributed transactions and the saga pattern
days.lab_task: Split the order system into order, inventory and payment services behind a gateway, with central configuration and a saga that cancels an order when payment fails.
days.deliverable: Service repositories, Compose file and saga sequence diagram
checks: Order is cancelled and stock released
Change a setting in the config server
Service picks it up after refresh
Call a service through the gateway with a v1 and v2 path

days.lab_task: Protect the order service's calls to payment with a timeout, retry, circuit breaker and bulkhead, then inject latency and failures with Toxiproxy and show the service staying responsive.
days.deliverable: Resilience configuration, chaos test results and metrics graph
checks: Add 5 seconds of latency to payment
Order calls fail fast after the timeout
Circuit opens and fallback is used
Circuit closes after the half-open trial

days.topic: Distributed Tracing and Observability for Java Services
subtopics: Exporting traces to Jaeger or Tempo
days.lab_task: Instrument the three services with OpenTelemetry, follow one order through the gateway, services and Kafka in Jaeger, and build a Grafana dashboard for latency, errors and JVM memory.
days.deliverable: Tracing setup, trace screenshot and dashboard export
checks: One trace shows every service and the Kafka hop
All log lines for the order are found
Latency, error rate and heap are shown

days.topic: Advanced Spring Security with OAuth2 and OpenID Connect
subtopics: OAuth2 roles: client, resource server, authorisation server
days.lab_task: Replace the custom JWT login with Keycloak, protect each service as a resource server with scope rules, relay tokens through the gateway and use client credentials between services.
days.deliverable: Keycloak realm export, security configuration and tests
checks: Call inventory with a token lacking the inventory scope
Services accept new tokens without restart
objectives: Secure services with OAuth2 and OIDC

subtopics: Injection in SQL, JPQL and logs
Software bill of materials with CycloneDX
Static analysis with SpotBugs and SonarQube
days.lab_task: Find and fix five planted vulnerabilities in a service, add dependency scanning and an SBOM to the build, and make the build fail on a high-severity finding.
days.deliverable: Fixed code, scan reports, SBOM and build configuration
checks: Add a dependency with a known critical CVE
Build fails with the CVE listed
Send an XXE payload to the XML endpoint

days.topic: Advanced Testing: Contract, Integration and Mutation Testing
subtopics: Consumer-driven contracts with Spring Cloud Contract or Pact
days.lab_task: Add contract tests between order and inventory, mutation-test the pricing module and raise its mutation score to 80 percent, and add ArchUnit rules that enforce the layering.
days.deliverable: Contract tests, PIT report and ArchUnit rules
checks: Change the inventory response field name
Call a repository from a controller

subtopics: Building images with Jib or Buildpacks
JVM container awareness and memory limits
Class data sharing for faster start
days.lab_task: Build images for the services with Jib and Buildpacks, set memory limits and JVM flags so the container is not killed, add health probes and compare image sizes and start times.
days.deliverable: Image build configuration, comparison table and scan report
checks: Run with a 512 MB limit under load

days.topic: Native Images and Fast Startup with GraalVM
days.lab_task: Compile the inventory service to a native image, fix the reflection errors with the tracing agent, and compare start time, memory and throughput with the JVM version.
days.deliverable: Native build configuration and comparison table
checks: Call an endpoint that uses reflection
Participant explains where the JVM is faster

subtopics: Resource requests, limits and JVM sizing
days.lab_task: Deploy the services to Kubernetes with probes, graceful shutdown and autoscaling, then run a rolling update under load and confirm no requests fail.
days.deliverable: Manifests or Helm chart, load test results and scaling graph
checks: Roll out a new version under load
Participant diagnoses OOMKilled and fixes the limits

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Production-Grade Java Microservices Platform
subtopics: Load test, demo and design defence
days.lab_task: Deliver an e-commerce platform of at least three services with Kafka events, sagas, resilience, OAuth2 security, contract tests, Kubernetes deployment and tracing, then load-test and present it.
days.deliverable: Source repositories, deployment files, load test report, dashboards and a 20-minute demo
checks: Kill the payment service during a load test
Orders are compensated and no data is lost
Follow one order in the tracing tool
Complete trace across services and Kafka
Run the contract and mutation tests
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
